description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'NewsListItem' that displays a news article with an image, title, and timestamp. It also includes an internal '_ArticleImage' widget for image handling.

classes.name: NewsListItem
classes.description: A stateless widget representing an individual news article item, displaying image, title, and time.

classes.name: _ArticleImage
classes.description: A private stateless widget for displaying a network image or placeholder/error icons.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the NewsListItem widget, arranging image, title, and timestamp layout.

methods.name: _formatTime
methods.description: Formats the article's time as either an absolute date or relative hours ago.
